reuse.why: Every month-wide action, including the new setLastMonthSpending and copyPreviousMonth, routes its category decision through shouldWriteMonthBudgetCategory and uses extractTagsFromText and the existing notes table; setLastMonthSpending still flips the sign itself instead of using the new averageBudgetAmount-style helper.

duplication.why: The category query (categories + group + notes joins) is pasted into setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg rather than shared, and the expense-sign rule is written again in setLastMonthSpending.

placement.why: Rules and actions stay in server/budget/actions.ts and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts beside its siblings.

scope.why: Changes are confined to the month-wide actions, the new method and tests.

maintainability.why: A single predicate is a real improvement, but it carries an unused speculative 'action' parameter and the five copied queries mean a column/join change still has to be made five times.

bypasses_abstraction.where: setLastMonthSpending computes cat.is_income === 0 ? -spending : spending inline instead of the shared sign helper.

disguised_duplication.where: The five category SELECTs are the same query with only whitespace/indentation differences; the sign rule in setLastMonthSpending restates averageBudgetAmount under different names.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldWriteMonthBudgetCategory gains an unused 'action' discriminator and includeHiddenCategories with its conditional branch; setLastMonthSpending bypasses the shared sign helper.
